messages:
maya: planning rollout for 'tiered_fallback.v2' that falls back from HQ model -> quantized -> regional variant. want simple flags, clear aborts, and tenant opt-in.

sam: prefer hybrid canary: percent + tenant cohorts + opt-in. specifics?

maya: hybrid plan: 1% global percent, 5 pilot tenants (mid/enterprise), and ~10 opt-in startups. keep percent steady while tenant pilots run longer.

liam: telemetry checklist: p95 latency, 5xx+decode errors, per-tenant token usage, KV cache hitrate, cost-per-request. need traces to map lat spikes to cache misses.

maya: primary success gates: p95 <= baseline+20ms, error-rate delta <0.05%, cost-per-token delta <10% for canary groups.

sam: aborts: p95 > baseline+50ms for 5m OR error-rate +0.5% for 3m OR cost-per-token +20% sustained 10m. those should auto-roll back.

maya: flag sketch: 
```
feature: tiered_fallback.v2
props: mode=(percent|tenant|optin), percent=1, tenants=[pilot-a,pilot-b], disable_auto_fallback=true/false
policies: fallback_order=[local-quant, regional, hosted-compat]
```

tess: Dedicated customers? they can't tolerate auto fallback by default.

maya: Dedicated default: no auto-fallback. SRE exposes a per-pool canary toggle. flags will accept "disable_auto_fallback" per-tenant.

liam: ops runbook snippet for oscillation: 
1) check GPU load + cache miss
2) if single tenant oscillates -> mute flag for tenant
3) if global oscillation -> ramp percent down to 0.1% and page SRE
4) if cost spike -> force quantized fallback across canary

sam: add shadowing: mirror outputs to HQ model for quality eval (async), compute similarity metrics and prompt-based evals.

maya: rollout timeline: infra + dashboards this week, Tue internal 1% for 24h, Wed tenant pilots, Fri opt-in beta. keep canary 1% for 72h with rolling checks.

sam: alerts: create dashboard per-flag with p95, error-rate, cost delta; alerts per abort criteria (pager for enterprise issues, slack for devs).

maya: CSM ask: show expected token-cost delta in console for pilot tenants so they know tradeoffs.

tess: I'll prep pilot FAQ and opt-out instructions.

liam: on-call for Wed tenant window. I'll own runbook updates.

maya: tagging owners: @sam alerts, @liam runbook, @tess customer comms. I'll open PR for flag defs + dashboard templates.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature_flags/tiered_fallback_v2 -> rollout-plan/4390123456/init (dry-run)

maya: will post status in #customer-ops when internal canary starts. :thumbsup:

sam: SRE signed off on abort thresholds.

liam: after 24h we'll share telemetry snapshot and decide next ramp.

maya: closing loop, thanks everyone.
